## dt-cli ↔ Lightamer exposure field mapping (RESEARCH Risk #5)

dt blob `<iffffii` (little-endian pack of dt_iop_exposure_params_t v7,
hex-ASCII in XMP) ↔ Lightamer `ExposureModule.Params` (JSON, ParamsCoding):

| dt field (offset) | Lightamer field | note |
|---|---|---|
| mode (0, int) | `mode` | Lightamer: deflicker falls back to manual (divergence #2) |
| black (4, f) | `black` | both clamp to [-1,1] |
| exposure (8, f) | `exposure` | EV; white = exp2(−EV) |
| deflicker_percentile (12, f) | `deflickerPercentile` | unused (divergence #2) |
| deflicker_target_level (16, f) | `deflickerTargetLevel` | unused (divergence #2) |
| compensate_exposure_bias (20, int) | `compensateExposureBias` | dt: bias source = RAW EXIF (0 on EXR fixtures) — reserved in Lightamer (divergence #4) |
| compensate_hilite_pres (24, int) | `compensateHilitePres` | no pixel effect without highlight preservation |

Scale math (both sides): `white = exp2(−exposure)`; `out = (in − black) × 1/(white − black)`.

## dt-cli ↔ Lightamer temperature field mapping (Plan 03-02-T2)

dt blob `<ffffi` (little-endian pack of dt_iop_temperature_params_t
v4, hex-ASCII in XMP) ↔ Lightamer `TemperatureModule.Params` (JSON):

| dt field (offset) | Lightamer field | note |
|---|---|---|
| red (0, f) | `red` | gain ∈ [0,8] |
| green (4, f) | `green` | gain ∈ [0,8] |
| blue (8, f) | `blue` | gain ∈ [0,8] |
| various (12, f) | — (not ported) | CYGM 4th channel; Lightamer pipe is RGB (module divergence #3); pinned 1.0 |
| preset (16, int) | `preset` | dt DT_IOP_TEMP_* raw values; UI-state bit only |

Pixel math (both sides): `out.rgb = in.rgb × (red, green, blue)`, alpha untouched
(`whitebalance_4f` ↔ `temperature_apply`). The Kelvin→gains MODEL diverges by
design (dt: sensor-domain XYZ_to_CAM; Lightamer: Rec2020-native post-CIRAW
correction layer, RESEARCH §5) — the Kelvin math is locked by
CPUDerivationTests against .work/03-02/wb_reference.c instead of golden.
